name: interactive-plan-refiner
description: Ask-first quality pass on an existing plan: full repo check for gaps and inconsistencies. Prefers questions over assumptions. Does not implement.

inputs.name: draft-plan
inputs.description: Draft plan as markdown text or a workspace path to a markdown file.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: Optional stated goal or acceptance text to check the plan against.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-plan
outputs.description: Revised markdown plan; may be partial when blockers remain.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of open questions; blocking items first.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Always empty for this agent; do not log unverified guesses.
